output.title: T-shirt fold, bag, seal, label, tote pack

product.name: Online t-shirt shipment unit
product.description: A printed cotton T-shirt laid flat, machine-folded to 250 × 300 mm, placed into a poly bag, sealed, and labeled with an address sticker. Shipped as a unit inside a tote.

steps.name: LoadFlatShirt
steps.does: An operator places one laid-flat printed T-shirt onto the folding machine input.

steps.name: FoldTo250x300
steps.does: The machine folds the T-shirt to approximately 250 × 300 mm.

steps.name: InsertIntoPolyBag
steps.does: The folded shirt is slipped into a poly bag.

steps.name: PrintAndApplyAddressLabel
steps.does: An address label is printed and stuck onto the sealed bag.

steps.name: PlaceBagIntoTote
steps.does: The labeled sealed bag is placed into a tote for the shipping area.

output.quality: A second operator performs end-of-line quality checks (bag sealed correctly, label present and readable, no mis-folds). Any bad units are rejected/removed before entering the tote.
constraints: Discrete manufacturing/assembly line (not a continuous process).
Throughput requirement: 400 finished shirts per hour.
Two operators total: one for loading, one for quality checking.
Space/budget/machine availability were not specified; plan must fit within a straight conveyor-style line with a manual load and quality checkpoint.
assumptions: 400 shirts/hour is for completed packed units (sealed bag with label, placed into tote).
The shift length is 8 hours/day (since none was given).
The folded shirt thickness is ~20 mm (used only to size the product footprint; owner can correct).
Each unit is handled individually on the line (not batch cases/pallets).
Quality decision happens after label application and before the tote.

questions.question: What are the poly bag and label specifics: bag size (L×W) and how it’s sealed (heat sealer width/type vs. adhesive seal)?
questions.why: Determines the bag-handling and sealing station mechanics and cycle time.

questions.question: Is 400 shirts/hour the guaranteed sustained rate for the fully finished unit (after sealing + label), and is it per 8-hour shift?
questions.why: Sets the takt time budget across stations; affects whether any step needs to be parallelized.

questions.question: How many bags per tote (or tote size/weight limit), and is tote packing done continuously or in 'tote loads'?
questions.why: Determines the tote staging/accumulation behavior and the discharge/transfer station.
